methodology: To systematically decompose the provided information into atomic units, I analyzed each statement to identify distinct requirements, features, and constraints, ensuring each unit is independent, specific, and implementable.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Implement a timer that counts down for a given number of clock cycles.
Assert a signal to indicate the given duration has elapsed.
Use a down-counter to implement the timer.
Assert an output signal when the count becomes 0.
If load=1, load the internal counter with the 10-bit data.
The counter can be loaded at any time, even when counting.
If load=0, the internal counter should decrement by 1.
The output signal tc indicates whether the internal counter has reached 0.
Once the internal counter has reached 0, it should stay 0 until reloaded.
spec_atomic_units: The module defines a combinational logic circuit.
Input clk is part of the module's interface.
Input load determines whether the 10-bit data input is loaded into the counter.
The tc output signal indicates whether the counter has reached zero.
If load is asserted, the data input is loaded into the counter.
If load is not asserted, the counter decrements by 1 unless it has reached zero.
The tc signal is asserted when the counter value is zero.
The decrement operation is performed using a subtractor circuit.
The counter value remains zero once it reaches zero until reloaded.
